import unittest

from solution import latest_job_states


class LatestJobStatesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_latest_events_and_configured_order(self):
        configured = ["job-b", "job-a", "job-c"]
        events = [
            {"job_id": "job-a", "state": "queued", "meta": {"attempt": 1}},
            {"job_id": "ignored", "state": "done"},
            {"job_id": "job-b", "state": "running"},
            {"job_id": "job-a", "state": "done", "meta": {"attempt": 2}},
        ]
        result = latest_job_states(configured, events)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"job_id": "job-b", "state": "running"},
            {"job_id": "job-a", "state": "done", "meta": {"attempt": 2}},
            {"job_id": "job-c", "state": "missing"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(configured, ["job-b", "job-a", "job-c"])
        self.assertEqual(events[3]["meta"], {"attempt": 2})

    def test_returned_events_are_deep_independent(self):
        nested = {"values": [1]}
        events = [
            {"job_id": "a", "state": "ok", "data": nested},
            {"job_id": "b", "state": "ok", "data": nested},
        ]
        result = latest_job_states(("a", "b"), events)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["data"], nested)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["data"], result[1]["data"])
        result[0]["data"]["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(events[0]["data"]["values"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["data"]["values"], [1])

    def test_empty_collections(self):
        self.assertEqual(latest_job_states([], []), [])
        self.assertEqual(latest_job_states((), ({"job_id": "x", "state": "ok"},)), [])

    def test_invalid_containers_and_configured_ids(self):
        for configured, events in ((None, []), ([], None), ({"a"}, []), ([], {})):
            with self.subTest(configured=configured, events=events), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                latest_job_states(configured, events)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            latest_job_states([1], [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            latest_job_states([""], [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            latest_job_states(["a", "a"], [])

    def test_all_events_are_validated_even_if_unconfigured(self):
        invalid_events = [
            [1],
            [{}],
            [{"job_id": "x"}],
            [{"state": "ok"}],
            [{"job_id": 1, "state": "ok"}],
            [{"job_id": "x", "state": 1}],
            [{"job_id": "", "state": "ok"}],
            [{"job_id": "x", "state": ""}],
        ]
        for events in invalid_events:
            with self.subTest(events=events), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                latest_job_states([], events)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
